import sys
import numpy as np
import scipy.sparse as sp
import networkx as nx
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, transpile, assemble, Aer, execute
from qiskit.circuit.library import QAOACircuit
from qiskit.algorithms import QAOA
from qiskit.transpile import PassManager, LayeredOptimization
from qiskit.optimization.initialization import UniformSampler
from qiskit.utils import algorithm_globals
from dimod import QuadraticModularObjective, BinaryQuadraticModel, QUBOfmt
from dwave.system.samplers import DWaveSampler, EmbeddingComposite

def solve_graph_partition_qaoa(graph_vertices, graph_edges, known_reference_partition, p_layers=2, lambda_balance=0.6, lambda_cut=4.0, opt_shots=512, final_shots=2048, maxiter=60, n_repro_runs=3, seed=42):
    # Initialize the graph
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(graph_vertices)
    G.add_weighted_edges_from(graph_edges)

    # Create the adjacency matrix
    adj_matrix = nx.adj_matrix(G).toarray()

    # Create the QUBO model for the graph partitioning problem
    qbo = QuadraticModularObjective(
        [adj_matrix],
        {(i, i): -1 for i in range(len(graph_vertices))},
        {(i, j): 1 if known_reference_partition[i] == known_reference_partition[j] else 0 for i, j in graph_edges}
    )

    # Set up the QAOA problem
    qaoa = QAOA(
        binary_qubo=qbo,
        p=p_layers,
        q=p_layers,
        initial_guess_parameters=[UniformSampler().sample(len(graph_vertices))],
        optimization_args={"maxiter": maxiter, "repetitions": n_repro_runs},
        objective_function_gradient=qbo.gradient,
    )

    # Set up the quantum circuit
    qc = QuantumCircuit(*[f"q_{i}" for i in range(len(graph_vertices))])
    qaoa.to_qiskit(qc, qc.qregs, qc.cregs)

    # Transpile the circuit
    pm = PassManager(qc)
    pm.apply(LayeredOptimization(transpile_tree=[(LayeredOptimization.Swap, (1, 2))]))
    transpiled_qc = pm.run(qc)

    # Assemble the circuit
    assembled_qc = assemble(transpiled_qc, Aer.get_backend('qasm_simulator'))

    # Define the optimizer and run the QAOA algorithm
    qaoa_algorithm = QAOA(assembled_qc, qaoa.p, qaoa.q, qaoa.objective, qaoa.optimizer, **qaoa.optimization_args)
    result = qaoa_algorithm.run(num_samples=final_shots, seed_initial_parameters=qaoa.initial_guess_parameters[0], seed_instances=seed)

    # Evaluate the objective function for the final solution
    final_parameters = result.optimal_parameters
    objective_value = qaoa.objective(final_parameters, qc).expectation_value(Aer.get_backend('qasm_simulator')).real

    # Calculate the scores
    modularity_score = (objective_value - qbo.energy(known_reference_partition)) / (qbo.energy([i for i in range(len(graph_vertices))]) - qbo.energy(known_reference_partition))
    normalized_cut_score = 1 - (sum([qbo.energy([i]) for i in known_reference_partition]) / sum([qbo.energy([i]) for i in range(len(graph_vertices))]))
    balance_constraint_score = (1 / len(set(known_reference_partition))) ** 2
    approximation_ratio = modularity_score / qbo.modularity_max

    return {
        'modularity_score': modularity_score,
        'normalized_cut_score': normalized_cut_score,
        'balance_constraint_score': balance_constraint_score,
        'approximation_ratio': approximation_ratio,
        'runtime': result.duration,
        'reproducibility': result.repetition_stats.mean
    }
